name: Power of Siberia branches to Olekminsk, Aldan, Chulman, Murya (Sakha)
monitor_reason: length: no per-branch length sourced; only aggregate 550 km (2026-2030 programme, includes inter-settlement/in-village distribution lines for 27 settlements). Sponsor (Gazprom, programme signed 2025-10-09 with Sakha govt) and region are met; per-branch endpoints/lengths and design status unpublished. Branches (GRS Aldan, Aldan-2, Murya, Chulman) are gas-distribution spurs likely well under 25 km each except possibly Aldan; split and re-check when Gazprom publishes design.
researcher_notes: Not P7600/P3175/P2706 (P2706 = cancelled Yakutsk-Aldan). yakutia.info 2025-10-10: Gazprom-Sakha gasification programme 2026-2030 signed 9 Oct 2025 at St Petersburg gas forum; 4 branch pipelines with GRS Aldan, Aldan-2, Murya, Chulman off Power of Siberia; 16 Olekminsk-district villages; 550 km total pipelines, 9.8bn RUB; GRS Iengra branch due end-2025. neftegaz.ru (2018-era) says Gazprom designing 4 branches+GRS and 4 inter-settlement lines for Aldan, Olekminsk, Bechencha, Murya, Iengra. No per-branch length found in two searches. Route: none.
